tools.name: lookup_pin
tools.description: Look up an Indian six-digit PIN code: the post offices that use it (with India Post taluk), the state, and the district (the current district from the Local Government Directory where it can be matched safely by Census 2011 code, otherwise India Post's own label, which says which). Source: India Pos

tools.name: lookup_place
tools.description: Which district is an Indian town or locality in? Returns matches with district, state, the basis (a town page with a Local Government Directory district, or India Post's label that the directory does not confirm) and a link to the page. About 19,000 towns and localities; old names such as Bangalore

tools.name: holidays_on
tools.description: Public holidays for the US (federal), GB (England and Wales, Scotland, Northern Ireland), AU (states and territories) or CA (federal and provinces) for 2026 to 2028. Give a date (YYYY-MM-DD) or a year, and optionally a region such as NSW, Scotland or ON. A date also matches a holiday's legal date (f

tools.name: next_holiday
tools.description: The next public holiday day on or after a date (default today, UTC) for the US, GB, AU or CA, optionally in one region. Same data and sources as holidays_on.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: lookup_pin · Public sink: lookup_pin, lookup_place.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: lookup_pin · Public sink: lookup_pin, lookup_place

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
